subject: Joint solution lab — architecture immersion (availability check)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Morales <gina.morales@cloudport.io>, partners@cloudport.io
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Joint solution lab — architecture immersion (availability check)

Hi Gina / CloudPort team,

Thanks again for agreeing to partner on the joint solution lab. The goal for the session is to run a focused architecture immersion: validate end-to-end topology for the marketplace connector, confirm auth/KMS flows for private tenants, and walk through fault scenarios (regional failover + fallback model variants).

High-level agenda (draft) attached: agenda-draft.pdf.
- 15m: Introductions & success criteria
- 45m: Architecture walkthrough (network, auth, data flow)
- 30m: Integration validation plan + test harness
- 30m: Next steps / rollouts

Can you share availability windows across next week so we can lock a 2-hour block (we'd prefer a 90–120 minute workshop)? We can run in PST morning (9–12) or PST afternoon (13–16). If helpful, I can send a short availability poll, or Camila can coordinate calendars.

Note: we'll bring the runtime engineers and a solutions architect — Camila will confirm attendees. Also attaching a network diagram stub for initial review: redwood-cloudport-network-diagram.png.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Irene — thanks for the note and the agenda. Looks great. Tomas and I reviewed the draft diagram and have two quick asks before we lock time:
1) Can you confirm whether the session requires access to a staging VPC or whether a diagram-only review suffices initially?
2) We have a legal requirement to confirm data retention controls when discussing KMS flows — is there an internal doc we can reference in advance?

Availability from CloudPort: Dec 7 (09:00–12:00 PST), Dec 8 (13:00–16:00 PST), or Dec 9 (09:00–11:00 PST). Dec 6 is fully booked. We prefer the morning slot on Dec 7 if that works for Redwood.

If it helps, I can accept a calendar invite for the proposed 2-hour window on Dec 7 09:30–11:30 PST.

Best,
Gina Morales
Director of Integrations | CloudPort

Hi Gina — thanks for the quick reply and the proposed dates. Dec 7 09:30–11:30 PST would work for CloudPort, however two notes from our side: 

1) Our runtime team just flagged a conflicting large-scale benchmark scheduled for the morning of Dec 7. To avoid resource contention, would you be open to Dec 7 11:00–13:00 PST or Dec 8 09:30–11:30 PST instead? Both slots still fit within your originally listed availability windows.

2) Regarding staging access — for the first session we recommend diagram-only review. If we decide to run integration tests in-session, we'll provision a temporary staging VPC and share access steps ahead of time.

3) For the KMS/data-retention ask: Marissa is adding the retention summary and a short security FAQ to the Confluence page. Please expect a link from me shortly.
